name: Walter-Schottky-Institut / TUM 5112 exterior study

identity.qualification: Identity inferred from close footprint match and exact official street address; not an official BVV-to-TUM identifier mapping.

references.qualification: Small 100×78 official exterior image. Confirms dark facade with light rectangular external framing; insufficient for precise window dimensions. Not bundled as a texture.

Long south faces 1/22 and north 8 show window tiers and pale framing; east/west end walls 3/4 have broad opaque upper portions. Occluded openings, supports and heights still require qualified digitization.

references.publisher: TUM press release, 17 July 2008, syndicated by Informationsdienst Wissenschaft
references.qualification: Clear 800×400 historic south exterior photograph, used for architectural observation only. Source restricts reuse to the press-release context; pixels are not redistributed or bundled as textures.

observations: The clear TUM press photograph shows three window levels on the long south facade, with dark spandrels, pale projecting vertical and horizontal framing, and fine window mullions. This corrects the earlier tentative two-level reading from low-resolution projections and the OSM building:levels=2 tag.

South-facing survey walls 1 and 22 align with the three-tier press photograph. The approximately 9.46 m facade height accommodates three tiers; exact opening and frame dimensions remain estimates. The north projection shows two clearly readable window bands but its intermediate level is inconclusive and must not be assumed symmetric.
The large east and west end walls have a taller opaque roof portion. BVV supplies the stepped and pitched roof geometry; it must not be replaced with a single flat box.
The historic photo shows an external stair at the far short end. Its present state and geometry need confirmation from newer source references before modeling.
qualification: BVV preserves the surveyed envelope and roof. South window tiers and external framing follow the TUM press photograph and private aligned projections. Exact opening bounds, frame section/depth, colours, obscured end-wall glazing and north-window bands are estimated; north does not repeat the south three-tier pattern. Reference pixels are not bundled. No interiors.
